CJP Launches Nationwide 'Kya Bolti Public' Campaign

Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) has announced a nationwide membership drive and public dialogue initiative named 'Kya Bolti Public'. The organization stated it is a social entity focused on changing political discourse rather than supporting or opposing political parties. The campaign aims to engage youth and includes plans for a crowdfunding initiative and the appointment of leaders for five national zones. CJP also announced plans for student outreach, with some reports mentioning collaboration with AISA and the Congress party for these drives.
